players.bio: Archie Finn Collins is an English professional footballer who last played as a midfielder for EFL League One club Huddersfield Town.

Ashley Michael Fletcher is an English professional footballer who plays as a forward for EFL League One club Huddersfield Town. Fletcher began his professional career at Manchester United, having previously played at Bolton Wanderers during his youth.
Bali Mumba is a 24-year-old English professional footballer who plays as a versatile left wing-back, full-back, or winger for Huddersfield Town A.F.C. in EFL League One.

Bojan Radulović-Samouković (born 29 December 1999) is a professional footballer who plays as a striker for Huddersfield Town. Born in Spain, he has represented Serbia at under-19 level. bia at under-19 level.

Cameron James Nii Adjei Ashia (born 22 April 2005) is an English professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL League One club Huddersfield Town. Career In July 2022, Ashia joined the Derby County academy after having impressed scouts at a Fox Soccer Academy Showcase event. He departed the club upon the expiration of his scholarship at the end of the 2022–23 season.

Cameron Humphreys is an English professional midfielder currently playing for Sky Bet League One side Huddersfield Town on a season-long loan from Premier League club Ipswich Town. Humphreys, a product of the Ipswich Town Academy, made his first-team debut for the club in 2021. He has since made 22 appearances and scored two goals for Ipswich Town.
Daniel Jared Vost is an English professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL League One club Huddersfield Town.
David Ayomide Kolade Kasumu (born 5 October 1999) is an English professional footballer who plays as a central midfielder for EFL League One club Huddersfield Town.

Derensili Sanches Fernandes (born 28 May 2001) is a Dutch footballer who plays for Eredivisie club Excelsior Rotterdam. Career Fernandes started playing for Neptunus before joining up with Excelsior Rotterdam youth academy. He was moved to Excelsior's senior squad early in the 2020–21 season, but remained on the bench and did not make his professional debut.

Ethan Craig Brierley (born 23 November 2003) is an English professional footballer who plays as a central midfielder for Huddersfield Town. Early life Brierley was born in Rochdale. Career Having supported Rochdale from the age of three and progressed through the club's academy, Brierley was named on Rochdale's bench for a FA Cup match against Newcastle United in January 2020, at the age of 15.
Herbie Kane is an English professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL League One club Huddersfield Town.
Ibane Bowat (born 15 September 2002) is a professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for EFL League One club Huddersfield Town. Born in England, he is a youth international for Scotland.

Ilias Bronkhorst (born 10 May 1997) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays for EFL League One club Huddersfield Town. Club career He made his Eerste Divisie debut for Telstar on 31 August 2018 in a game against Jong FC Utrecht, as a 69th-minute substitute for Melle Springer. On 25 August 2023, Bronkhorst signed a one-season contract with Dordrecht.

Jack David Vincent Whatmough (born 19 August 1996) is an English professional footballer who plays for EFL League One club Huddersfield Town as a centre-back. Whatmough was born in Gosport, and played for Southampton. At the age of 13 he decided to leave Southampton F.C. He then went training with Portsmouth and joined their Academy still only aged 13.

Jak Alnwick is an English professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for EFL League One club Huddersfield Town. He turned professional at Newcastle United in 2008, and went on to represent England at under-17 and under-18 levels. He spent time on loan at Gateshead in the 2011–12 season, and played eight Premier League games for Newcastle in the 2014–15 season.

Joseph David Low (born 20 February 2002) is a Welsh professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for EFL League One club Huddersfield Town and the Wales national team. Club career Low joined the youth academy of Bristol City, and worked his way up all their youth categories. In February 2019, he had a short loan with Dorchester Town.
Joseph William John Taylor (born 18 November 2002) is a professional footballer who plays as a forward for EFL League One club Huddersfield Town and is a Wales under-21 international.
Lasse Sørensen (born 21 October 1999) is a Danish professional footballer who plays mainly as a wing back for EFL League One club Huddersfield Town.

Lynden Jack Gooch (born December 24, 1995) is an American professional soccer player who plays as a winger or wing-back for League One side Huddersfield Town. Gooch was born in Santa Cruz, California on December 24, 1995, son of an English father (born in Colchester) and an Irish mother (born in Dublin). His father is a professional football coach. At an early age, he joined the U.S.

Marcus Anthony Myers-Harness (born 24 February 1996) is an Irish-English footballer who plays as a winger for Huddersfield Town. He made his competitive first team debut for Burton Albion in September 2013, at the age of 17.
Marcus Samuel Michael McGuane (born 2 February 1999) is an English professional footballer who plays as a central midfielder for EFL League One club Huddersfield Town.
Martin Drury (born 10 April 1986) is an English football coach and former player who is the manager of EFL League One club Huddersfield Town.
Matthew Young (born 24 November 2006) is an English professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for EFL League One club Huddersfield Town on loan from Premier League club Sunderland.

Murray Wallace (born 10 January 1993) is a Scottish professional footballer who plays as a defender for Huddersfield Town. He also played for the Scotland under-20 and under-21 football teams, after beginning his career in his native Scotland playing for Falkirk in the Scottish First Division in the 2011–12 season.
Nikola Chivarov Tzanev (born 23 December 1996) is a New Zealand professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper ..

Radinio Roberto Balker (born 3 September 1998) is a professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for EFL League One club Huddersfield Town. Born in the Netherlands, he represents the Suriname national team.

Ryan Graham Ledson (born 19 August 1997) is an English professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL League One club Huddersfield Town. Ledson joined Everton's academy at the age of five. On his 17th birthday, he signed his first professional deal with the club, for three years.
Samson Jolaoluwa Gbolohan Tovide is an English footballer who plays as a centre-forward who plays for EFL League One club Huddersfield Town.
Sean Patrick Roughan (born 14 March 2003) is an Irish professional footballer who plays as a defender for Huddersfield Town.
